instruction: Turn around 180 degrees.  Go through the open door to the loft.  Once through the doorway, turn to the left and walk towards the far side of the loft.  Stop once you are just past the opening to the stairs.

steps.thought: The instruction says to turn around 180 degrees first, so I will rotate fully (12 x 15° turns) and then re-observe to find the open door to the loft.
I've turned 180° already per the 8 executed turns? Actually 8 turns = 120°, so I need 4 more right turns to complete 180°, which will also aim me toward the open door on the right.
I've completed the 180-degree turn and the open door to the loft is visible ahead, slightly left. I'll align with the doorway and step through.
The open door to the loft is ahead, slightly left of center. I'll advance through the doorway, then turn left as instructed.

I'm in the loft facing left toward the railing area. I need to walk toward the far side, passing the stairs opening, so I'll advance a few steps and re-observe.
I'm through the doorway into the loft, facing the railing. The instruction says turn left and walk toward the far side, stopping just past the stairs opening. I'll turn left and advance carefully.
I'm in the loft facing the railing. The stairs opening should be to my left, so I'll turn left and advance a couple of steps before re-observing.

I'm in the loft walking along the railing; the stairs opening should be just ahead along this walkway. I'll advance a couple steps and re-check.
